reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here shows reviews, Trustpilot or a track record, so I'd Google 'is norafurnish legit' first and likely move on to a brand I already know. I have 40 pendants pinned and plenty of established places to buy from.
objection: Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it? Plus I can't tell whether this store is legit, and a $360 fixture I'd have to return at my own cost if it looks cheap in person is a risk.
would_change_my_mind: Visible UL/ETL listing on each product page, plenty of independent verified reviews (Trustpilot, photos from real customers), and free return shipping or a sample/swatch of the paper shade material.
